title: X6891-16.3.0.150SP09-OP005PF001AZ-16.3.0.155SP08-OP005PF001AZ_20260917155316
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6891-16.3.0.155SP08(OP005PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
1. Updated Google Security Patch to September 5, 2026.

Fixed Issues:
Games
1. Fixed issues in some games where controller button recognition was incorrect or button mapping was misaligned.

Smoothness
1. Improved the responsiveness of text editing after cropping screenshots, making text resizing and rotation more responsive.
2. Fixed the occasional black screen issue when launching apps in quick succession, making app switching more stable.
3. Fixed lag when taking scrolling screenshots on the Facebook home page for a smoother experience.
4. Fixed lag when launching Visha and home screen icon flickering, making the home screen and app launches more stable.

Stability
1. Fixed the issue where games could occasionally freeze in Performance Mode, making gameplay more stable.
2. Fixed the occasional transfer failure issue with Tap to Share, improving the stability and success rate of file transfers.
3. Fixed the issue where the "Intelligent Perception Service Has Stopped" message could appear after the fingerprint enrollment page remained idle, reducing unnecessary interruptions.

Control Center
1. Improved the display of titles on the device controls page in Control Center, making the text clearer and more prominent.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
